scenes.headline: What a browser can draw this week
scenes.sub: Skia on WebGPU, and an apartment from 20 photos
scenes.say: I'm Gesso. Two reposts this week, both about what a browser can draw now. First, a renderer that finally runs on the web.

steps.say: skia-wasm compiles Skia's Graphite renderer to WebAssembly and runs it on the page's own WebGPU device.
Here it draws a video and the webcam as textures, through colour filters.

scenes.title: Where a frame goes, on the phone

heads: The whole difference is the submit
params.cause: immediates and storage buffers off, not WebGPU itself

steps.say: Ten thousand rounded rectangles, on a phone. Recording the drawing calls takes about the same time in both libraries.
Then the submit. CanvasKit's flush is a sliver. Graphite's snap, insert and submit takes longer than the drawing did.
Counted on the laptop, CanvasKit sends four WebGL calls. skia-wasm sends over thirty thousand WebGPU calls, one draw per item.
The cause is a setting in Graphite's Dawn backend under Emscripten. The phone already supports what a fix needs.

scenes.title: The wasm file, raw bytes
scenes.say: It is also lighter. I weighed both packages: about a quarter smaller than the full CanvasKit, with fewer features.

steps.say: Now a room you can walk through. An apartment, splatted from 20 phone photos.
And a painted twin, made by restyling the same frames with an image model.

scenes.title: Pose, generate, splat, in Atlas's docs

steps.say: First every photo gets a camera and a depth map, all in one world.
Then Atlas paints new views where no photo looked, with depth.
Then a refined splat run reconstructs the room and trains it against views it renders itself. Five dollars.
For the painted version, the frames were restyled and splatted again.
Here are the photos as cameras, floating in the point cloud.
The docs are plain about the generated views.
Beyond a small move, Atlas invents what the view shows.

scenes.text: A generated view is a guess at geometry nobody photographed. Fine for a painted walk, not for a measurement.

recap: skia-wasm loses on submit, not on recording
scenes.say: skia-wasm loses on submit, not on recording. And the apartment is 35 frames, 15 of them invented.
